findings.issue: Global aria-label substring does not prove the navigation landmark has an accessible name; a label on unrelated content would pass.
findings.correction: Inspect the actual nav start tag or constrained nav fragment and require its aria-label=주요 탐색. Keep real browser landmark/keyboard check.

findings.issue: Separate global checks for /hr href and aria-current permit current marker on the wrong link or element.
findings.correction: Extract the /hr anchor start tag inside nav and require aria-current=page there; assert no other navigation link is current in this focused case.

accepted_properties: Existing renderer/DTO boundary makes missing h1/skip target a genuine semantic RED after test compilation; no missing runtime infrastructure is used as RED.
Default denied ShippingScreens retains empty shell; only offered destinations drive nav. No permission inferred from role/title or client navigation.
Sibling Omitted/Empty/Failure/Rows preserved; People module successor separately covers both partial-failure and denied directions.
One light visual system, readable Korean/long text, native landmarks/disclosures and no unnecessary static collection islands match prototype adaptation.
No fixture product route, fake controls, unmounted forms or client-created success. Root shared writer and independent module files preserve ownership.
implementation_guardrails: CompanyView is a list projection; do not label its first/only item as current Company/Group without an explicit owner-selected scope projection. A Company collection does not establish Group scope.
Preserve existing schema-required data attributes and compatible links until separately accepted successor; no extra restricted attributes to implement visual reference.
Do not mechanically attach skip/navigation to default denied render_shell because existing contract requires no href/nav there.
Shared CSS must match module tokens; People module uses inherited accent rather than a competing theme.
limits: Presentation review only; no native Account business authority or release qualification inferred.
Actual browser visual/keyboard/320px/200% checks and independent screenshot critique still follow root implementation.
